arguments.cmd:
cd /work && python - <<'EOF'
src = open('model.scad').read()
old = '''["crank_turn", ["gear1"], "rotate", [x1, y_c, 0], [0, 0, 1], [0, 360],'''
new = '''["crank_turn", ["gear1"], "rotate", [x1, y_c, 0], [0, 0, 1], [0, 360],
                ["held", ["gear2", "gear3", "gear4"]],'''
print("assembly motion:", src.count(old))
old2 = '''        ["assembly_order", [
            [["base", "gear1", "gear2", "gear3", "gear4"], [0, 0, 0]]
        ]],'''
new2 = '''        ["assembly_order", [
            [["base", "gear1", "gear2", "gear3", "gear4"], [0, 0, 0]]
        ]],
        ["held", ["gear1", "gear2", "gear3", "gear4"]],'''
print("assembly_order:", src.count(old2))
src = src.replace(old, new).replace(old2, new2)
open('model.scad','w').write(src)
print("done")
EOF
